name: MakerBot Thing-O-Matic ABP 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; Koordinaten: Bettecke (Exporter verschiebt um -53 / -60)
G161 X Y F2500 ; home XY axes minimum
G162 Z F1000 ; home Z axis maximum
; MB_NATIVE G92 Z10 ; set Z to 10
G1 Z0 F900 ; move Z down 10
G162 Z F150 ; home Z axis maximum
M132 X Y Z A B ; Recall stored home offsets
G1 X78 Y0 Z10 F3300.0 ; move to waiting position
G130 X20 Y20 A20 B20 ; Lower stepper Vrefs while heating
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] T0 ; Set platform (bed) temperature
M134 T0 ; Wait for platform to reach temperature
M135 T0 ; Load right Toolhead
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0 ; Set extruder temperature
M133 T0 ; Wait for Toolhead to heat
G130 X127 Y127 A127 B127 ; Set Stepper motor Vref to defaults
; Anker Extruder (MiracleGrue anchorExtrusionAmount/anchorWidth)
M135 T0
G1 X78 Y3 Z0.2 F3300
G92 E0
G1 E10 F120 ; Blob, 10 mm bei 2 mm/s
G1 X98 Y3 E3.326 F900
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
M18 A B ; Turn off A and B Steppers
G1 Z155 F900
G162 X Y F2000
M18 X Y Z ; Turn off steppers after a build
M140 S0 T0
M104 S0 T0
M70 P5 ; We <3 Making Things!
M72 P1 ; Play Ta-Da song
